text: {"translations":{"fr":"Qui veut le miel doit accepter les piqûres d’abeilles.","es":"Quien quiere miel tiene que soportar las picaduras de las abejas.","it":"Chi vuole il miele deve sopportare le punture delle api.","en":"If you want the honey, you have to put up with the bee stings."},"feeling":["neutral"],"cultural_notes":[{"expression":"lli bgha l3sel ysber l9ris n7el","literal":"Whoever wants honey must endure the bees’ stings.","meaning":"Good things often require patience and a willingness to face difficulties."}],"confidence":"high"}

translations.es: Quien quiere miel tiene que soportar las picaduras de las abejas.
translations.it: Chi vuole il miele deve sopportare le punture delle api.

text: {"translations":{"fr":"Tu es devenue grande comme un palmier, mais tu ne sais toujours pas cuisiner !","es":"Te has puesto alta como una palmera, ¡pero todavía no sabes cocinar!","it":"Sei diventata alta come una palma, ma ancora non sai cucinare!","en":"You’ve grown as tall as a palm tree, but you still haven’t learned to cook!"},"feeling":["humor","love"],"cultural_notes":[],"confidence":"high"}

translations.fr: Tu es devenue grande comme un palmier, mais tu ne sais toujours pas cuisiner !
translations.es: Te has puesto alta como una palmera, ¡pero todavía no sabes cocinar!
